overview.oneLineTake: The AI leadership trade is cracking while defensives catch a bid, so expect wider swings until the inflation data settles the rate path.
themes: AI trade is fraying. Nvidia gave back about $240 billion in market value as the Huang comeback rally cooled, and Anthropic closed below its $83 IPO price.
Nasdaq led losses. QQQ fell 1.99% to 638.10 on Nov 24 while SPY slipped 0.49% to 718.78, as money rotated into defensives and value.
Dispersion is wide. Dell beat on AI strength with a $25 billion buyback, while HPE sank on margin worries and Micron weakened on supply glut warnings.
Rates are quiet for now. Treasury yields were steady ahead of Fed inflation data, though silver fell on rate-hike worries.
Consumer confidence jumped after the midterms, but inflation worries persist.
risks: Nvidia governance and Washington scrutiny of Huang, including export-control pressure from Senators.
A hot inflation print would revive rate-hike pricing and hit long-duration tech.
Hormuz tension: Iran says three tankers hit mines despite U.S. escort, with sanctions widening.
Thin holiday liquidity into Thanksgiving amplifies swings after the recent whiplash rallies.

nq.summary: NDX cash fell 1.99% to 26,214 Tuesday as Monday's Huang squeeze faded and semis dumped. NQ is pressing the session low with Asia risk off, so the bounce is failing ahead of PCE in thin pre-Thanksgiving trade. Thesis: mildly bearish, 4/10, sell rips below 26,434. Invalidation: hold above 26,434. NDX levels: resistance 26,434 (Tue H), 26,500 (round), 26,746 (Mon close); support 26,000 (round), 25,935 (Tue L), 25,500 (round).
